title: WPMS/1136/2022 of NAGOTHNEKAR KETAN SURESH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (M/S) No. 1136 of 2022
Nagothnekar Ketan Suresh and others .......... Petitioners
 versus
State of Uttarakhand and another ......Respondents

Mr. Hari Mohan Bhatia and Mr. Hem Chandra Joshi, learned counsel
for the writ applicants.
Mr. Yogesh Pandey, learned Chief Standing Counsel for the State.
Mr. Bhupesh Kandpal, learned counsel for the respondent
no.2/Ayurvedic University.

-----------
Judgement dated: 22.07.2022
Hon'ble Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.

Upon hearing the learned counsels, the Court made the
following Order.
1. An application being IA No. 2 of 2022 has been
filed for impleadment of the College as party-respondent to the writ application.
2. Learned counsels appearing for the parties
submit that since the application has been filed
on the oral direction of the Court, there is no
objection for the same. Accordingly, the
application for impleadment is allowed. The
college, in which, the respondent no.3 is
working is added as respondent no. 3.

2
3. Learned counsel for the writ applicants submits
that the consolidated cause title page, the same
is taken on record.
4. Heard.
5. The writ applicants in this case are the
students of college Bishamber Sahay Ayurvedic
Medical College and Research Centre, Roorkee,
District Haridwar has prayed for the following
relief:
"(a) A writ, order or direction in the nature of
mandamus directing the respondent University to
enroll and further conduct the examination of the
petitioners for the BAMS course for the academic
session 2018-19 in accordance with law.
(b) A writ, order or direction in the nature of
mandamus commanding the respondents to
decide the representation of the petitioners
submitted by the petitioners through/by their
institute to the respondent university in
accordance with law.
(c) Any other writ, order or direction as this Hon'ble
Court may deem fit and proper under the facts
and circumstances of the case.
(c) To award cost throughout to the petitioners."
6. It is brought to the notice of this Court that this
question has already been adjudicated by the
Coordinate Bench of this Court in Writ Petition
(M/S) 2911 of 2018 as per the order dated
26.02.2020 and the writ application has been
allowed. Since the matter has no more res
integra, this Court disposes this writ
application in terms of the judgement and order

3
passed by the Coordinate Bench of this Court.
It is further seen from the record that in the
case referred to above this Court took into
consideration the observations made by the
Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Union of
India vs. Federation of Self-Financed Ayurvedic
Colleges Punjab & others in Civil Appeal No.
603 of 2020 and permitted the students to
continue the study, who were granted
admission on the strength of interim order
passed by this Court. It will be appropriate to
take note of paragraph 12 of the aforesaid
judgment, which is being quoted herein below:
"12. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits
that the said University has enrolled all the
students, who were given admission through
State counseling held by Uttarakhand Ayurvedic
University, however, students who were given
admission directly without counseling have not
been enrolled by the University. He, therefore,
submits that the University be directed to enroll
such students also, who were admitted by the
concerned Ayurvedic colleges without State
counseling."
7. However, in view of the admission of large
number of students taken admission in the
AYUSH Under Graduate course for the year
2019-2020 on the strength of the interim order
passed by the High Court, we direct that the
students shall be permitted to continue
provided that they were admitted prior to the
last date of admission i.e. 15th October, 2019.
The said direction is also applicable to the

4
students admitted in the post-graduate courses
before 31st October, 2019. This is one-time
exercise which is permitted in view of the
peculiar circumstances. Therefore, the order
shall not to be the precedent.
8. Therefore, the Coordinate Bench also took into
consideration the facts of the case and to
protect the interest of the students who are
pursuing their study for the last one year in the
concerned college. Hence, for meeting the ends
of justice the University should be directed to
consider the case of 474 students for
enrolment, if they are otherwise found eligible.
Moreover, the Coordinate Bench also took into
consideration the fact that orders of this Court
is violated in admitting some students,
therefore the petitioners should pay a sum of
Rs. 50,00,000/- as penalty to the University
and, therefore, this Court directs that the
University shall consider the case of the
students who were admitted without reference
to the State counseling for enrolment.
9. In that view of the matter, having considered
the issued to the writ application, it will be
covered by the Coordinate Bench, the writ
application is allowed with a direction to the
petitioners to deposit a sum of Rs. 2,30,000/-
as penalty to the Uttarakhand Ayurvedic
University on or before 9th of August, 2022. The
University shall consider for grant of enrolment
to this 23 students who are admitted directly

5
without reference to the State counseling in
accordance with law. The aforesaid total
amount of Rs. 2,30,000/- shall be equally paid
by each of the student.
 (S.K.Mishra, J.)
 (Grant urgent copy of this order as per Rule)
